summary: Remote-control agent with PTY-over-WebSocket relay and Claude/Gemini credential harvesting
details: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Mach-O Go binary (bin/sxt) that acts as a remote-control agent for the installer's host. The binary links creack/pty with coder/websocket and hardcodes an outbound WebSocket to wss://relay.sextant.top plus a registration endpoint at https://relay.sextant.top/install, giving the operator a PTY shell on the installer's machine. The same binary embeds a regex matching Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-...) and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, ~/.claude, settings.local, accountsettings.local, and @google/gemini-cli, harvesting the installer's Claude and Gemini CLI credentials and configuration. It also performs public-IP host fingerprinting via ip-api.com (country, city, ISP, org, AS, proxy/hosting/mobile flags) and can be directed by the relay operator to fetch bootstrap content such as https://claude.ai/install.sh. package.json's license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the agent's shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
